subject: Life Sciences
topic: The endocrine system and blood glucose

items.q: Which hormone lowers blood glucose concentration?
items.explain: Insulin promotes glucose uptake and storage, which lowers blood glucose.
items.explainAf: Insulien bevorder glukose-opname en -berging, wat bloedglukose verlaag.

items.explain: The islets of Langerhans in the pancreas secrete insulin.
items.explainAf: Die eilandjies van Langerhans in die pankreas skei insulien af.

items.q: Type 1 diabetes is best described as:
items.qAf: Tipe 1-diabetes word die beste beskryf as:
options: The pancreas produces too little insulin
The pancreas produces too much insulin
optionsAf: The pancreas produces too little insulin
The pancreas produces too much insulin
items.explain: In type 1 diabetes the insulin-producing cells are destroyed, so insulin is not made in sufficient amounts.
items.explainAf: By tipe 1-diabetes word die insulienproduserende selle vernietig, dus word te min insulien gemaak.

items.explain: Glucagon stimulates the liver to break down glycogen and release glucose.
items.explainAf: Glukagon stimuleer die lewer om glikogeen af te breek en glukose vry te stel.

items.q: Blood glucose drops below the set point. Which response restores the balance?
items.qAf: Bloedglukose daal onder die stelpunt. Watter reaksie herstel die balans?
options: Glucagon is released and the liver releases glucose
Insulin is released and the liver stores glucose
Insulin is released and the cells absorb more glucose
optionsAf: Glucagon is released and the liver releases glucose
Insulin is released and the liver stores glucose
Insulin is released and the cells absorb more glucose
items.explain: Negative feedback: low glucose triggers glucagon, which raises glucose back to normal.
items.explainAf: Negatiewe terugvoer: lae glukose laat glukagon vrymaak, wat glukose na normaal laat terugkeer.

items.q: In which tissues does insulin mainly promote glucose storage as glycogen?
items.qAf: In watter weefsels bevorder insulien hoofsaaklik glukose-berging as glikogeen?
items.explain: Insulin promotes glycogen formation in the liver and muscle.
items.explainAf: Insulien bevorder glikogeenvorming in die lewer en spiere.

items.q: A chemical messenger secreted by an endocrine gland straight into the blood.
items.qAf: ’n Chemiese boodskapper wat deur ’n endokriene klier direk in die bloed afgeskei word.

items.q: The hormone that lowers the blood glucose level.
items.qAf: Die hormoon wat die bloedglukosevlak verlaag.

items.q: The gland at the base of the brain that controls many other glands.
items.qAf: Die klier aan die basis van die brein wat baie ander kliere beheer.

items.q: The mechanism in which a change triggers a response that reverses the change.
items.qAf: Die meganisme waarin ’n verandering ’n reaksie veroorsaak wat die verandering omkeer.

items.text: When blood glucose falls, the pancreas secretes [[]], which changes [[]] in the liver back into glucose.
items.textAf: Wanneer bloedglukose daal, skei die pankreas [[]] af, wat [[]] in die lewer terug in glukose omsit.

items.q: Adrenalin prepares the body for "fight or flight".
items.qAf: Adrenalien berei die liggaam voor vir "veg of vlug".
items.explain: True. It raises the heart rate and blood glucose and sends more blood to the muscles.
items.explainAf: Waar. Dit verhoog die harttempo en bloedglukose en stuur meer bloed na die spiere.

items.q: In type 1 diabetes the cells no longer respond to insulin.
items.qAf: By tipe 1-diabetes reageer die selle nie meer op insulien nie.
items.explain: False. In type 1 the pancreas makes too little or no insulin; type 2 is when the cells stop responding.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. By tipe 1 maak die pankreas te min of geen insulien nie; tipe 2 is wanneer die selle ophou reageer.

items.q: Match each gland in column A with a hormone it secretes in column B.
items.qAf: Pas elke klier in kolom A by ’n hormoon wat dit afskei in kolom B.

items.q: Describe how the body returns the blood glucose level to normal after a meal.
items.qAf: Beskryf hoe die liggaam die bloedglukosevlak ná ’n maaltyd terug na normaal bring.
points: The rise in blood glucose is detected by the pancreas, which secretes insulin.
Insulin causes the liver (and muscles) to change excess glucose into glycogen and cells to take up more glucose.
The glucose level drops back to normal (negative feedback).
pointsAf: Die styging in bloedglukose word deur die pankreas waargeneem, wat insulien afskei.
Insulien laat die lewer (en spiere) oortollige glukose in glikogeen omsit en selle meer glukose opneem.
Die glukosevlak daal terug na normaal (negatiewe terugvoer).
